comment.description: A one-line comment to prefix the generated config file.

server.description: LDAP server hostname or IP address; used if server_uri is empty.

port.description: LDAP server port; used if server_uri is empty.

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate file for LDAP server validation.

login.description: Distinguished name for LDAP bind; empty means anonymous.

password.description: Password for LDAP bind; must be secured (0400 permissions on config file).

base.description: Base DN for LDAP search; required.

queryfilter.description: LDAP search filter for user lookup; macros $recipient, $sender, $subject available.

result.description: LDAP attribute to use as the auto-reply body.

map_fields.description: List of additional LDAP attribute → macro mappings for body substitution. Each item must contain attribute and name fields (see items below).

blockfiles.description: Directory for storing blockfiles to prevent duplicate replies.

umask.description: File mode for newly created blockfiles.

blockexpire.description: Block duration in hours before re-allowing auto-reply to same sender.

maxreceivers.description: Maximum number of recipients per incoming message.

maxheader.description: Maximum number of header lines before rejecting message.

badheaders.description: Path to db-file of header patterns to ignore (e.g., for mailing lists).

blacklist.description: Path to db-file of email addresses excluded from auto-replies.

forceheader.description: Path to fixed header file (should end with empty line).

mta.description: Path to the MTA binary to use for sending mail.

mta_args.description: Arguments passed to the MTA binary.

charset.description: Character set (e.g., 'utf-8', 'iso-8859-1') for body encoding conversion via iconv.

recvheader.description: Whitespace-separated list of header fields to scan for receiving addresses.
